title: fix(explore): fallback to fields if y-axis isn't provided in saved query
body: ## Changes Addresses [BROWSE-783](https://linear.app/getsentry/issue/BROWSE-783/fix-empty-query-columns). Older discover queries have y-axis as an optional field, causing an empty query column in the all queries table. This adds a util to fallback to the first aggregate in table fields or `count()` which mirrors what each individual saved query page currently does. ### Before ### After
